title.en: Three Mine Ledgers, One Public Purse

desc.zh: 公会自报利润，公共防务与救济却缺钱。登记费按开启时年收入快照；已付不退。第一本日志派发登记、审计与对账五件事。
desc.en: The guilds self-report profit while public defence and relief go short. The filing fee is captured at entry and is never refunded. The first journal dispatches registration, audit and reconciliation.

desc.zh: 开工公账、连续观察与结项。低目标成熟后不能跳成高标准结局。
desc.en: The opening public account, continuous observation and settlement. A mature narrow target cannot be promoted into the high-standard ending.

title.en: Three Ledgers the Guilds Report

desc.zh: 矿场按生产规模登记，公会只交一本自报账。防务、官署与救济的缺口要有人认账。本线只读真实矿场就业、税收法律与预算，不会凭空造矿或赠送工业。
desc.en: Mines register by production scale while the guilds hand over a single self-reported book. Defence, administration and relief all show a gap. This line reads real mine employment, tax law and the budget; it never creates mines or grants industry.

label.zh: 公共审计：官署雇会计对账
label.en: Public audit: clerks on the public payroll

options.effect: { ywc_lan_choose_mine_audit = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1001 } }

cost_note.zh: 一次登记费按开启时年总收入÷52快照；并按基础费率实付；另需有岗官署。
cost_note.en: One-time filing fee snapshots opening annual gross income / 52; charged at the base rate; needs a staffed office.

consequence_note.zh: 税源上升，但股东不满；后续需维持官署就业与矿业规模。
consequence_note.en: Tax base rises while shareholders resent it; later nodes check office staffing and mine scale.

label.zh: 股东包税：公会按额上缴
label.en: Shareholder farming: the guild pays a fixed sum

options.effect: { ywc_lan_choose_mine_farm = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1001 } }

cost_note.zh: 一次登记费按开启时年总收入÷52快照；按七折费率收取；行政成本最低。
cost_note.en: One-time filing fee snapshots opening annual gross income / 52; charged at 70% of base; lowest administrative cost.

consequence_note.zh: 短期钱多、行政便宜，长期税基被侵蚀，后续分红门槛更低。
consequence_note.en: Money now and cheap to run, but the long-run tax base erodes and later dividend gates are weaker.

label.zh: 自报加限责：不改制度只加抽查

options.effect: { ywc_lan_choose_mine_limited = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1001 } }

cost_note.zh: 一次登记费按开启时年总收入÷52快照；按半价费率收取；只登记有限责任与抽查。
cost_note.en: One-time filing fee snapshots opening annual gross income / 52; charged at half the base rate; registers liability and audits only.

consequence_note.zh: 成本最低，但公共收入增长有限，只能走低目标结局。
consequence_note.en: Cheapest, but public revenue grows only marginally and only the narrow ending is reachable.

cost_note.zh: 不另收费用。
cost_note.en: No new fee.

consequence_note.zh: 可以重试；退出保留已付费用并记录受挫。
consequence_note.en: Retry remains available; withdrawal keeps paid fees and records a setback.

cost_note.zh: 保留已付费用与已签义务。
cost_note.en: Paid fees and signed obligations remain.

consequence_note.zh: 记录受挫并幂等释放本线名额。
consequence_note.en: Records a setback and releases this arc slot idempotently.

purpose.zh: 三条真实财政路线：公共审计、股东包税、自报加限责，各有不同的行政与税源后果。
purpose.en: Three real fiscal routes with different administrative and revenue consequences.

title.en: The Clerks Want Into the Mining District

desc.zh: 有岗官署与真实矿场就业决定谁真的能查账。资金不足时本事件不收费、也不推进。
desc.en: Staffed offices and real mine employment decide who can actually audit. Without funds this event charges nothing and advances nothing.

label.en: Send clerks from a staffed office

options.effect: { ywc_lan_mine_open_ledger = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1002 } }

cost_note.zh: 不新增一次性费；官署工资本身由预算承担。
cost_note.en: No new one-time fee; office wages stay on the budget.

consequence_note.zh: 后续节点读取官署就业与会计岗位是否仍在。
consequence_note.en: Later nodes read whether the office and clerks remain.

options.effect: { ywc_lan_mine_open_guild_ledger = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1002 } }

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用；抽查频率下降。
cost_note.en: No new fee; audit frequency falls.

consequence_note.zh: 公共收入增长受限，只能走向窄结局。
consequence_note.en: Public revenue grows only marginally and only the narrow ending opens.

cost_note.zh: 不另收费用。
cost_note.en: No new fee.

consequence_note.zh: 可以重试；退出保留已付费用并记录受挫。
consequence_note.en: Retry remains available; withdrawal keeps paid fees and records a setback.

cost_note.zh: 保留已付费用与已签义务。
cost_note.en: Paid fees and signed obligations remain.

consequence_note.zh: 记录受挫并幂等释放本线名额。
consequence_note.en: Records a setback and releases this arc slot idempotently.

purpose.zh: 把审计能力落到真实官署就业或公会账房上。
purpose.en: Grounds audit capacity in real office employment or the guild's own bookkeeping.

title.zh: 股东要分红，公款也要分
title.en: Shareholders Want a Dividend, the Public Purse Wants a Share

desc.zh: 按股分红会挤掉公共防务与救济。三种登记路径在这里第一次被真实读取。
desc.en: Dividends by share crowd out public defence and relief. This is where the three registered routes are first read against real conditions.

label.zh: 公款优先：先留防务与救济
label.en: Public purse first: defence and relief before dividends

options.effect: { ywc_lan_mine_public_share = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1003 } }

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用；分红延后。
cost_note.en: No new fee; the dividend is deferred.

consequence_note.zh: 股东不满，后续需要真实限责或审计支撑。
consequence_note.en: Shareholders resent it; later nodes need real liability or audit backing.

options.effect: { ywc_lan_mine_dividend_share = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1003 } }

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用；公共进项较低。
cost_note.en: No new fee; the public take is lower.

consequence_note.zh: 公共收入目标下调，结局不能冒充高标。
consequence_note.en: The public revenue target drops and the ending cannot claim the high standard.

cost_note.zh: 不另收费用。
cost_note.en: No new fee.

consequence_note.zh: 可以重试；退出保留已付费用并记录受挫。
consequence_note.en: Retry remains available; withdrawal keeps paid fees and records a setback.

cost_note.zh: 保留已付费用与已签义务。
cost_note.en: Paid fees and signed obligations remain.

consequence_note.zh: 记录受挫并幂等释放本线名额。
consequence_note.en: Records a setback and releases this arc slot idempotently.

purpose.zh: 第一次按真实条件读取已登记路线。
purpose.en: The first read of the registered route against real conditions.

title.en: The Shipping Firm Sends Its Reconciliation

desc.zh: JHG 船运对账能证明矿石真的出港。外部伙伴缺席时，本线只核内部产量与库存，不虚构伙伴。
desc.en: A JHG shipping reconciliation can prove ore actually left the port. Without a real partner this line only checks internal output; it invents no partner.

label.zh: 采用船运对账单核对出港量

options.effect: { ywc_lan_mine_use_freight = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1004 } }

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用；只读真实港口与生产关系。
cost_note.en: No new fee; reads real ports and production only.

consequence_note.zh: 矿账与出港量对不上时后续不能确立。
consequence_note.en: A mismatch between ledger and shipments blocks later establishment.

options.effect: { ywc_lan_mine_internal_only = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1004 } }

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用，目标降低。
cost_note.en: No new fee; the target drops.

consequence_note.zh: 不冒称外部核验已完成。
consequence_note.en: Does not claim external verification was completed.

cost_note.zh: 不另收费用。
cost_note.en: No new fee.

consequence_note.zh: 可以重试；退出保留已付费用并记录受挫。
consequence_note.en: Retry remains available; withdrawal keeps paid fees and records a setback.

cost_note.zh: 保留已付费用与已签义务。
cost_note.en: Paid fees and signed obligations remain.

consequence_note.zh: 记录受挫并幂等释放本线名额。
consequence_note.en: Records a setback and releases this arc slot idempotently.

purpose.zh: 把对账落到真实港口与产量上，不虚构贸易伙伴。
purpose.en: Grounds reconciliation in real ports and output without inventing partners.

title.zh: 海关要把矿账并进关单
title.en: Customs Wants the Mine Ledger on Its Own Slips

desc.zh: SHU 海关账目能交叉核对税额。贸易法律与真实港务岗位决定这条路是否可行。
desc.en: SHU customs accounting can cross-check the assessed tax. Trade law and staffed ports decide whether that route is open.

label.zh: 并入关单，接受交叉核对
label.en: Merge into customs and accept cross-checks

options.effect: { ywc_lan_mine_merge_customs = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1005 } }

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用；须现有港口与贸易法。
cost_note.en: No new fee; needs an existing port and trade law.

consequence_note.zh: 税源更实，但公会抵触加深。
consequence_note.en: A firmer tax base, but guild resistance deepens.

options.effect: { ywc_lan_mine_separate_books = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1005 } }

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用，交叉核对缺失。
cost_note.en: No new fee; the cross-check is absent.

consequence_note.zh: 只能走窄目标结局。
consequence_note.en: Only the narrow ending remains reachable.

cost_note.zh: 不另收费用。
cost_note.en: No new fee.

consequence_note.zh: 可以重试；退出保留已付费用并记录受挫。
consequence_note.en: Retry remains available; withdrawal keeps paid fees and records a setback.

cost_note.zh: 保留已付费用与已签义务。
cost_note.en: Paid fees and signed obligations remain.

consequence_note.zh: 记录受挫并幂等释放本线名额。
consequence_note.en: Records a setback and releases this arc slot idempotently.

purpose.zh: 海关并账是真实可选项，但取决于贸易法与港务岗位。
purpose.en: Customs merging is real but depends on trade law and staffed ports.

title.en: Count the Public Account Before the Shift

desc.zh: 公共审计、股东包税与自报加限责在这里给出不同的起步代价。付款失败只保留退路。
desc.en: Public audit, shareholder farming and self-report each carry a different opening cost. A failed payment only preserves the retreat.

label.zh: 拨足审计人手与限责登记

options.effect: { ywc_lan_mine_fund_audit = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1006 } }

cost_note.zh: 一次登记费按开启时年总收入÷52快照；第二期审计准备金。
cost_note.en: One-time filing fee snapshots opening annual gross income / 52; second audit reserve.

consequence_note.zh: 税源上升最实，成本也最高。
consequence_note.en: The firmest revenue gain, at the highest cost.

label.zh: 压低公共索款，换公会配合
label.en: Cap the public claim to keep the guild onside

options.effect: { ywc_lan_mine_cap_claim = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1006 } }

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用；公共进项封顶。
cost_note.en: No new fee; the public take is capped.

consequence_note.zh: 只能走低目标结局。
consequence_note.en: Only the low target can conclude.

cost_note.zh: 不另收费用。
cost_note.en: No new fee.

consequence_note.zh: 可以重试；退出保留已付费用并记录受挫。
consequence_note.en: Retry remains available; withdrawal keeps paid fees and records a setback.

cost_note.zh: 保留已付费用与已签义务。
cost_note.en: Paid fees and signed obligations remain.

consequence_note.zh: 记录受挫并幂等释放本线名额。
consequence_note.en: Records a setback and releases this arc slot idempotently.

purpose.zh: 三种路线在真实预算上给出不同起步代价。
purpose.en: The three routes carry different real budget costs at the start.

title.en: Three Ledgers After Six Months

desc.zh: 只有连续六个月公共款项真实进账，才可进入结项复核。任何坏月立即清零。
desc.en: Only six consecutive months of real public receipts open the settlement review. Any bad month clears the timer.

label.zh: 确认连续六个月，进入结项复核
label.en: Confirm six months and open the review

options.effect: { ywc_lan_mine_begin_review = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1007 } }

cost_note.zh: 不再收第二次登记费。
cost_note.en: No second filing fee.

consequence_note.zh: 提前结项不能替代连续六个月。
consequence_note.en: Concluding early cannot substitute for the six months.

label.zh: 缩限目标或等待条件恢复

options.effect: { ywc_lan_mine_narrow_target = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1007 } }

cost_note.zh: 已付不退；未达标月份不收费。
cost_note.en: Paid fees stay; failing months cost nothing.

consequence_note.zh: 观察从零重新开始。
consequence_note.en: Observation restarts from zero.

cost_note.zh: 不另收费用。
cost_note.en: No new fee.

consequence_note.zh: 可以重试；退出保留已付费用并记录受挫。
consequence_note.en: Retry remains available; withdrawal keeps paid fees and records a setback.

cost_note.zh: 保留已付费用与已签义务。
cost_note.en: Paid fees and signed obligations remain.

consequence_note.zh: 记录受挫并幂等释放本线名额。
consequence_note.en: Records a setback and releases this arc slot idempotently.

purpose.zh: 连续观察而非截止日：坏月清零，缩限后重新计时。
purpose.en: Continuous observation rather than a deadline: a bad month zeroes the timer.

title.en: Which Ledger the Public Purse Follows

desc.zh: 结项读取当前税源、官署就业、矿业规模与路线。低目标成熟后不能跳成高标准结局。
desc.en: Settlement reads current revenue, office employment, mine scale and the registered route. A mature narrow target cannot jump to the high standard.

cost_note.zh: 无结局奖金；经常性支出仍由预算承担。
cost_note.en: No closing bonus; recurring costs stay on the budget.

consequence_note.zh: 只在真实高目标连续合格时成立。
consequence_note.en: Only holds when the real high target held continuously.

label.zh: 以缩限后的公共份额结项
label.en: Settle on the narrowed public share

cost_note.zh: 无结局奖金。
cost_note.en: No closing bonus.

consequence_note.zh: 只兑现窄目标，不冒认全面审计。
consequence_note.en: Delivers only the narrow target, not a full audit.

cost_note.zh: 保留已付费用与已签义务。
cost_note.en: Paid fees and signed obligations remain.

consequence_note.zh: 记录受挫并幂等释放本线名额。
consequence_note.en: Records a setback and releases this arc slot idempotently.

purpose.zh: 结局只按当前真实条件分档，不允许低目标跳高标准。
purpose.en: Endings are tiered by current real conditions only.

title.zh: 水路要穿过已经有人的上游
title.en: The Waterway Crosses Ground Already Occupied

desc.zh: 矿业与运输扩张画出新的区块，区块里有既存的聚落与耕地。土地法决定谁有权谈，基础设施决定这条路值不值得修。
desc.en: Mining and transport expansion draws new blocks over existing settlements and farmland. Land law decides who may negotiate and infrastructure decides whether the works are worth it.

label.zh: 赔偿共管：付钱并设共管机构

options.effect: { ywc_lan_choose_river_compensate = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1011 } }

cost_note.zh: 一次登记费按开启时年总收入÷52快照；并按赔偿标准实付；需真实官署承接。
cost_note.en: One-time filing fee snapshots opening annual gross income / 52; plus compensation; needs a real staffed office.

consequence_note.zh: 动荡下降，成本最高。
consequence_note.en: Unrest falls at the highest cost.

options.effect: { ywc_lan_choose_river_restrict = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1011 } }

cost_note.zh: 一次登记费按开启时年总收入÷52快照；按半价费率收取；放弃部分产出。
cost_note.en: One-time filing fee snapshots opening annual gross income / 52; charged at half rate; output is forgone.

consequence_note.zh: 动荡可控，产出目标降低。
consequence_note.en: Unrest stays contained and the output target drops.

label.zh: 私卫执行：成本低见效快

options.effect: { ywc_lan_choose_river_guards = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1011 } }

cost_note.zh: 一次登记费按开启时年总收入÷52快照；按四折费率收取；另付私卫佣金。
cost_note.en: One-time filing fee snapshots opening annual gross income / 52; charged at 40% of base plus guard fees.

consequence_note.zh: 真实增加激进派并损失合法性，不能既不付钱也不承担动荡。
consequence_note.en: Really adds radicals and costs legitimacy; responsibility cannot be both unpaid and unrest-free.

desc.zh: 工钱与缴费、连续观察与按档结项。责任不能既不付钱也不承担动荡。
desc.en: Wages and contributions, continuous observation, tiered settlement. Responsibility cannot be unpaid and unrest-free at once.

title.en: Who Pays After the Shift

desc.zh: 伤病、工钱与移民债务由谁承担。劳动与福利法律、真实矿工就业与预算决定可选路线。
desc.en: Who carries injury, wages and migration debt. Labour and welfare law, real mine employment and the budget decide which routes are open.

label.zh: 互助基金：先付启动金再按月缴
label.en: Mutual fund: seed money then monthly contributions

options.effect: { ywc_lan_choose_fund_mutual = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1021 } }

cost_note.zh: 一次登记费按开启时年总收入÷52快照；并按月缴费，启动金较高。
cost_note.en: One-time filing fee snapshots opening annual gross income / 52; plus monthly contributions; high seed cost.

consequence_note.zh: 生活水平上升，股东成本上升。
consequence_note.en: Living standards rise and shareholder costs rise.

options.effect: { ywc_lan_choose_fund_company = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1021 } }

cost_note.zh: 一次登记费按开启时年总收入÷52快照；按七折费率收取；公共支出低。
cost_note.en: One-time filing fee snapshots opening annual gross income / 52; charged at 70% of base; low public spending.

consequence_note.zh: 企业破产时出现赔付缺口。
consequence_note.en: A payout gap opens if the firm fails.

label.en: Private relief: almost no public money

options.effect: { ywc_lan_choose_fund_private = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1021 } }

cost_note.zh: 不另收费用；覆盖面窄。
cost_note.en: No new fee; the coverage is narrow.

consequence_note.zh: 生活水平与动荡恶化，不能既不付钱也不承担动荡。
consequence_note.en: Living standards and unrest deteriorate; it cannot be both unpaid and unrest-free.

cost_note.zh: 不另收费用。
cost_note.en: No new fee.

consequence_note.zh: 可以重试；退出保留已付费用并记录受挫。
consequence_note.en: Retry remains available; withdrawal keeps paid fees and records a setback.

cost_note.zh: 保留已付费用与已签义务。
cost_note.en: Paid fees and signed obligations remain.

consequence_note.zh: 记录受挫并幂等释放本线名额。
consequence_note.en: Records a setback and releases this arc slot idempotently.

purpose.zh: 三条责任路线各有真实出资与动荡后果。
purpose.en: Three liability routes with real funding and unrest consequences.

title.zh: 缴费名册上的第一个名字
title.en: The First Name on the Contribution Roll

desc.zh: 真实矿工就业决定名册能覆盖谁。没有真实就业时只登记较小目标。
desc.en: Real mine employment decides who the roll can cover. Without it only a smaller target is registered.

label.zh: 按真实矿工就业登记名册

options.effect: { ywc_lan_fund_enrol_mine = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1022 } }

cost_note.zh: 不新增一次性费；月度缴费开始计。
cost_note.en: No new one-time fee; monthly contributions start.

consequence_note.zh: 后续节点读取同一就业与生活水平。
consequence_note.en: A later node reads the same employment and living standards.

options.effect: { ywc_lan_fund_small_roll = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1022 } }

cost_note.zh: 不新增一次性费；目标下调。
cost_note.en: No new one-time fee; the target drops.

consequence_note.zh: 只能走向窄结局。
consequence_note.en: Only the narrow ending remains.

cost_note.zh: 不另收费用。
cost_note.en: No new fee.

consequence_note.zh: 可以重试；退出保留已付费用并记录受挫。
consequence_note.en: Retry remains available; withdrawal keeps paid fees and records a setback.

cost_note.zh: 保留已付费用与已签义务。
cost_note.en: Paid fees and signed obligations remain.

consequence_note.zh: 记录受挫并幂等释放本线名额。
consequence_note.en: Records a setback and releases this arc slot idempotently.

purpose.zh: 名册规模由真实就业决定。
purpose.en: Roll size follows real employment.

title.en: Debt the Migrant Workers Brought

desc.zh: 移民工人的旧债与公司垫付纠缠。本事件只读真实法律与预算，不发明债务体系。
desc.en: Migrant debt entangles with company advances. This event reads real law and the budget only.

label.en: Let the fund assume the old debt

options.effect: { ywc_lan_fund_assume_debt = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1023 } }

cost_note.zh: 一次登记费按开启时年总收入÷52快照；承接准备金。
cost_note.en: One-time filing fee snapshots opening annual gross income / 52; assumption reserve.

consequence_note.zh: 生活水平改善，成本上升。
consequence_note.en: Living standards improve while costs rise.

label.en: Leave the debt with the company

options.effect: { ywc_lan_fund_company_debt = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1023 } }

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用；企业破产时出现缺口。
cost_note.en: No new fee; a gap opens if the firm fails.

consequence_note.zh: 只能走中档或窄结局。
consequence_note.en: Only the middle or narrow ending remains.

cost_note.zh: 不另收费用。
cost_note.en: No new fee.

consequence_note.zh: 可以重试；退出保留已付费用并记录受挫。
consequence_note.en: Retry remains available; withdrawal keeps paid fees and records a setback.

cost_note.zh: 保留已付费用与已签义务。
cost_note.en: Paid fees and signed obligations remain.

consequence_note.zh: 记录受挫并幂等释放本线名额。
consequence_note.en: Records a setback and releases this arc slot idempotently.

purpose.zh: 债务归属在真实法律下登记。
purpose.en: Debt liability is registered under real law.

title.en: The Fund or the Firm's Own Reserve

desc.zh: 福利法律与真实机构决定基金能否成立。付款失败只保留退路。
desc.en: Welfare law and real institutions decide whether the fund can exist. A failed payment only preserves the retreat.

label.zh: 按现行福利法律成立互助基金
label.en: Charter the fund under current welfare law

options.effect: { ywc_lan_fund_open_mutual = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1024 } }

cost_note.zh: 一次登记费按开启时年总收入÷52快照；第二期启动准备金。
cost_note.en: One-time filing fee snapshots opening annual gross income / 52; second seed reserve.

consequence_note.zh: 生活水平上升最实，成本最高。
consequence_note.en: The firmest living-standard gain at the highest cost.

options.effect: { ywc_lan_fund_firm_reserve = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1024 } }

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用；公共支出低。
cost_note.en: No new fee; low public spending.

consequence_note.zh: 破产时赔付缺口真实存在。
consequence_note.en: A payout gap really exists on bankruptcy.

cost_note.zh: 不另收费用。
cost_note.en: No new fee.

consequence_note.zh: 可以重试；退出保留已付费用并记录受挫。
consequence_note.en: Retry remains available; withdrawal keeps paid fees and records a setback.

cost_note.zh: 保留已付费用与已签义务。
cost_note.en: Paid fees and signed obligations remain.

consequence_note.zh: 记录受挫并幂等释放本线名额。
consequence_note.en: Records a setback and releases this arc slot idempotently.

purpose.zh: 基金成立与否取决于真实法律与机构。
purpose.en: Whether the fund can exist depends on real law and institutions.

title.en: The Savings Society Knocks

desc.zh: NMG 的互助传统可作参照，但不会凭空造出伙伴或免费保护。
desc.en: NMG's mutual traditions are a reference, but no partner or free protection is created.

options.effect: { ywc_lan_fund_borrow_practice = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1025 } }

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用；成本摊在月度缴费里。
cost_note.en: No new fee; costs sit in monthly contributions.

consequence_note.zh: 后续节点读取月度缴费是否连续。
consequence_note.en: A later node reads whether contributions stayed continuous.

options.effect: { ywc_lan_fund_decline_practice = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1025 } }

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用，目标降低。
cost_note.en: No new fee; the target drops.

consequence_note.zh: 只能走向窄结局。
consequence_note.en: Only the narrow ending remains.

cost_note.zh: 不另收费用。
cost_note.en: No new fee.

consequence_note.zh: 可以重试；退出保留已付费用并记录受挫。
consequence_note.en: Retry remains available; withdrawal keeps paid fees and records a setback.

cost_note.zh: 保留已付费用与已签义务。
cost_note.en: Paid fees and signed obligations remain.

consequence_note.zh: 记录受挫并幂等释放本线名额。
consequence_note.en: Records a setback and releases this arc slot idempotently.

purpose.zh: 外部做法只作参考，不创造伙伴。
purpose.en: External practice is a reference only; no partner is created.

title.en: Wages and Contributions Fall Due Together

desc.zh: 真实预算决定能否同时支付。公务员与官僚成本也在这里被真实读取。
desc.en: The real budget decides whether both can be paid. Administration costs are read here too.

options.effect: { ywc_lan_fund_pay_both = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1026 } }

cost_note.zh: 一次登记费按开启时年总收入÷52快照；第三期准备金。
cost_note.en: One-time filing fee snapshots opening annual gross income / 52; third reserve.

consequence_note.zh: 生活水平与动荡同时改善，成本最高。
consequence_note.en: Living standards and unrest both improve at the highest cost.

label.en: Pay wages first and defer contributions

options.effect: { ywc_lan_fund_pay_wages = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1026 } }

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用；覆盖缺口保留。
cost_note.en: No new fee; the coverage gap remains.

consequence_note.zh: 只能走窄结局。
consequence_note.en: Only the narrow ending remains.

cost_note.zh: 不另收费用。
cost_note.en: No new fee.

consequence_note.zh: 可以重试；退出保留已付费用并记录受挫。
consequence_note.en: Retry remains available; withdrawal keeps paid fees and records a setback.

cost_note.zh: 保留已付费用与已签义务。
cost_note.en: Paid fees and signed obligations remain.

consequence_note.zh: 记录受挫并幂等释放本线名额。
consequence_note.en: Records a setback and releases this arc slot idempotently.

purpose.zh: 预算同时支撑工钱与缴费才推进。
purpose.en: The budget must sustain both wages and contributions.

title.zh: 六个月里有没有人再来索赔
title.en: Did Anyone Else Claim in Those Six Months

desc.zh: 连续六个月观察生活水平与缴费。坏月清零，私人救济不能跳成互助基金结局。
desc.en: Six consecutive months of living standards and contributions. A bad month zeroes it, and private relief cannot jump to the mutual-fund ending.

label.zh: 确认连续六个月，进入结项复核
label.en: Confirm six months and open the review

options.effect: { ywc_lan_fund_begin_review = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1027 } }

cost_note.zh: 不再收第二次登记费。
cost_note.en: No second filing fee.

consequence_note.zh: 提前结项不能替代连续六个月。
consequence_note.en: Concluding early cannot substitute for the six months.

options.effect: { ywc_lan_fund_narrow_target = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_lan_pending_event value = 1027 } }

cost_note.zh: 已付不退；未达标月份不收费。
cost_note.en: Paid fees stay; failing months cost nothing.

consequence_note.zh: 观察从零重新开始。
consequence_note.en: Observation restarts from zero.

cost_note.zh: 不另收费用。
cost_note.en: No new fee.

consequence_note.zh: 可以重试；退出保留已付费用并记录受挫。
consequence_note.en: Retry remains available; withdrawal keeps paid fees and records a setback.

cost_note.zh: 保留已付费用与已签义务。
cost_note.en: Paid fees and signed obligations remain.

consequence_note.zh: 记录受挫并幂等释放本线名额。
consequence_note.en: Records a setback and releases this arc slot idempotently.

purpose.zh: 连续观察而非截止日。
purpose.en: Continuous observation rather than a deadline.

title.en: Who Holds the Liability After the Payout

desc.zh: 结项读取法律、生活水平、真实缴费与已登记路线，按档结局。
desc.en: Settlement reads law, living standards, real contributions and the registered route, tiered.

cost_note.zh: 无结局奖金；月度缴费继续。
cost_note.en: No closing bonus; monthly contributions continue.

consequence_note.zh: 只在真实高目标连续合格时成立。
consequence_note.en: Only holds when the real high target held continuously.

label.zh: 以缩限后的责任安排结项
label.en: Settle on the narrowed liability arrangement

cost_note.zh: 无结局奖金。
cost_note.en: No closing bonus.

consequence_note.zh: 只兑现窄目标，不冒认互助基金。
consequence_note.en: Delivers only the narrow target, not the mutual fund.

cost_note.zh: 保留已付费用与已签义务。
cost_note.en: Paid fees and signed obligations remain.

consequence_note.zh: 记录受挫并幂等释放本线名额。
consequence_note.en: Records a setback and releases this arc slot idempotently.

purpose.zh: 结局按真实条件分档。
purpose.en: Endings are tiered by real conditions.
